meta.revisionPolicy: Revised continuously; finalised over ~3 years. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: All-India, annual, each national-accounts line as a share of nominal GDP (current prices over current prices)
meta.note: Shares are nominal over nominal, the only honest form. Gross saving as a share of GDP lives in gdp-2022-accounts (saving_rate) and is not repeated.
